terms_text: Terms of use This bot is an independent price-tracking assistant for user-provided Trendyol product links. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Trendyol. The bot may store your Telegram user id, public Telegram profile fields, selected language, saved product links, notification settings, and local price history needed to provide alerts. Prices and product data may be delayed, incomplete, or different from the actual Trendyol page. Always check the final price on Trendyol before buying. You may stop using the bot at any time and delete your data with /delete_me.
privacy_text: Privacy The bot stores only data needed to provide price tracking: Telegram user id, public Telegram profile fields, language, product links you add, alert settings, and price history for your subscriptions. The bot does not ask for your Trendyol account password, payment card, address, or private Trendyol account data. Use /export csv to export your subscriptions. Use /delete_me to delete your profile, subscriptions, and related local price history.

start_text:
👋 *Price Tracker for Trendyol*

I watch Trendyol products for you and message you when a price drops or reaches your target.

*Fast start:*
1. Open a product on Trendyol.
2. Copy the product link and send it here.
3. I will save the product, remember its price, and show buttons for alerts, history, pause, and settings.

You can also use the buttons below: add a product, open your products, or browse trends.

help_text:
❓ Help

Most users only need one action: send a Trendyol product link. I will add it to tracking and show buttons for the next steps.

Main buttons:
• ➕ Add product - what link to send
• 📦 My products - tracked products, settings, pause, delete
• 🔥 Trends - product ideas
• ⭐ Premium - status and product limit
• ❓ Help - this guide

Useful commands: /mysubs, /alerts, /settings, /premium, /export, /import, /report
Details: /help full
help_full:
📚 Detailed help

First product:
1. Open a Trendyol product page.
2. Copy the product link from share/browser.
3. Send the link here.
4. I will save the product and show its control buttons.

Product controls:
• 🔄 Check price - manual refresh
• 🎯 Target price - alert when price reaches your number
• ⏸ Pause alerts - keep the product without notifications
• 📈 Price history - chart and previous prices
• ⚙️ Settings - mode, interval, target price

Notification modes:
• Discounts only - message arrives when the price drops.
• Every hour - scheduled current-price message.
• Target price - separate alert when the product reaches your price.

Commands:
• /mysubs - product list
• /alerts - target price overview
• /history NUMBER - price history
• /unsubscribe NUMBER - remove product
• /settings - quiet hours and advanced settings
• /premium - access status and product limit
• /export csv - export products
• /import - restore products from CSV/JSON export
• /language - language
• /report - contact admin

about_text:
ℹ️ About the bot

Price Tracker for Trendyol is an independent Faini Tech bot for tracking Trendyol products: it saves your watchlist, checks prices, keeps price history, and sends alerts for discounts or target prices.

What you can do:
• add products by link
• receive price-drop notifications
• set a target price
• view price history
• export and import subscriptions

The source code is available on GitHub. Use the button below to open the repository.
settings_usage:
Command for notification settings:
/settings quiet <start> <end> — configure quiet hours (0-23)
/settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent> — configure price alerts
/settings interval <product number> <minutes> — notification interval (min 15 minutes)
quiet_hours_usage:
Usage: /settings quiet <start> <end>
Example: /settings quiet 23 7 — quiet hours from 23:00 to 7:00
price_alerts_usage:
Usage: /settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent>
Example: /settings price 1 min:100 max:500 percent:10
interval_usage:
Usage: /settings interval <product number> <minutes>
Example: /settings interval 1 60 — notifications every hour
